missions.title: Free Roam: Old Town
missions.brief: No zombies, no clock: walk around the historic center.

missions.title: The Old Town
missions.brief: The historic center: the square, the church, the arcades. Hold it against 60 of them.

missions.title: Fiesta of Tokens
missions.brief: Twenty tokens lie around the old town. Grab them all before the bells stop.

missions.title: Lis in the Church
missions.brief: Lis is hiding in the church. Walk her out of town: she waits for you, the infected go for whoever is nearer.

missions.title: Run to the Church
missions.brief: Six checkpoints through the narrow streets. Follow the green beacon.

missions.title: Spoiled Supplies
missions.brief: Six crates of infected supplies. Break them one after another: each one buys you more time.

missions.title: Guard the Truck
missions.brief: The survivors are fixing their truck. Keep the infected off it: stand at a broken gate to put it back up.

missions.title: First Night in Town
missions.brief: The town is crawling with them. Put down 60 and keep breathing.

missions.title: Infested Wrecks
missions.brief: Something nests in the crashed cars. Blow them all up.

missions.title: Shaun at the Gas Station
missions.brief: Shaun is stuck across town. Bring him out alive.

missions.title: Downtown Horde
missions.brief: Downtown is bigger and the crowd is thicker. Clear the streets.

missions.title: Hold the Fort
missions.brief: The rescue is on its way. Stay alive behind the barriers until it lands.

missions.title: Who Let the Dogs Out
missions.brief: Their owners let them loose. Shoot the walkers before the dogs swarm you.

missions.title: Token Rush
missions.brief: Twenty tokens lie around the next town. Grab them all before the clock runs out.

missions.title: Matt Lost His Crew
missions.brief: Matt is alone in the villa. Take him to the edge of town.

missions.title: Through the Streets
missions.brief: Run through six checkpoints before the clock stops. Follow the green beacon.

missions.title: The Locked Cage
missions.brief: Survivors are locked in a cage. Find the three keys and get them out.

missions.title: Free Roam: Villa
missions.brief: No zombies, no clock: walk around the town.

heroes.title: Sam
heroes.brief: Was delivering pizza when it started. Still has the pistol.

heroes.title: Lis
heroes.brief: Punk drummer. Hit things for a living before; still does.

heroes.title: Matt
heroes.brief: Ran the crew of the old garage. Keeps his head when it counts.

heroes.title: Shaun
heroes.brief: Old mechanic with a moustache and a lot of stories.
